This is the base face of Tinkers' Construct's Clear Glass block (registry name TConstruct:GlassBlock). (c) the Tinkers'
Construct authors (the Tinkers' Construct team, Mantle and the GT New Horizons contributors; the file's commit authors
in the GT New Horizons fork are UltraProdigy and Johann Bernhardt).

The file is used only in the Missile Silo guide sheet (a documentation image), which paints it onto the glass rings. It
is not in the mod jar. The LGPL-3.0 applies to this file; it is replaceable by any other image of the same name.
